scenario.title: Last Stand at Thermopylae
intro.text:
LAST STAND AT THERMOPYLAE - 24 APR 1941

Levadia, Central Greece

The Empire forces have set up a defensive position at Thermopylae to cover the evacuation of their main forces. Hasten to meet them and take over their positions, so that these forces also have a chance to escape across the sea!

GOAL Hold after the tenth turn 7 VH, 6 VH or 4 VH for BV, V or TV!

NOTE In this mission the AI has the first turn!
player.speaker: Commander
line.reaction-6-0-briliant.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.reaction-6-0-briliant.text: The required formations embarked. The Navy reports an orderly lift. I still need the last rear-guard returns before I agree with that description.
line.reaction-6-1-victory-tactical.text: We have enough troops from Thessaloniki for another line. I haven't reconciled the men and equipment left behind. Don't issue a final strength until the ships are all checked.
line.reaction-8-0-briliant.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.reaction-8-0-briliant.text: The pass opened before the German blocking force could settle. The western columns are already feeding into the wider withdrawal toward Thermopylae.
line.reaction-8-1-victory-tactical.text: Metsovo is open, but some columns waited within sound of the fighting until the last roadblock fell. They will reach Thermopylae tired and still formed.
line.callback-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.callback-0.text: The first-tide battalions are ready. The hospital has arrived too, with patients missing from its list. I've asked the commandant to come and see me about them.
line.callback-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-1.text: The hospital sailed on the first tide from Thessaloniki. The veterans paid for those berths with hours on the quay, and neither group has forgotten.
line.callback-2.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.callback-2.text: The heavy group cleared the pass. Recovery is still dealing with the vehicles it broke doing so. Allow time for that before we use the method again.
line.callback-3.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.callback-3.text: Since those light groups crossed the ridges, every staff officer thinks there must be another path somewhere. I'll take a local guide's word before a pencil mark.
line.western-route-account.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.western-route-account.text: We went west for the battalions in danger of being cut off. Now the Thessaloniki men have joined us. Some are asking why their officers couldn't get our headquarters on the line. You'll have to speak to them.
line.central-route-account.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.central-route-account.text: The port kept us connected to the fleet. The western officers have joined us here and discuss only ammunition with me. They have questions about my recommendation; I wish they'd ask them.
line.scene-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.scene-0.text: These are the sailing times at Rafina and the trains south of Thebes. We have to hold long enough for both. Tell me now if one of your sectors cannot last until its assigned hour.
line.scene-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.scene-1.text: Ten villages, ten requests for a battalion. Brallos, Amfiklia, and Levadia can cover the roads with three. The other seven requests come with mayors attached.
line.decision.speaker: Dimitris Laskaris
line.decision.text: Do we make the enemy deploy across the whole line, or put the guns on those three hinges and keep the tractors facing south?
line.decision.choice.defend-the-broad-li: Distribute the guns and hold the broad delaying line.
Give infantry and artillery 15 experience, restore the core to at least eight strength, and fully rearm it.
line.decision.choice.hold-three-hinges.t: Concentrate on Brallos, Amfiklia, and Levadia and keep transport ready.
line.decision.choice.hold-three-hinges.h: Restore the core to at least eight strength, fully refuel and rearm it, and give reconnaissance 10 experience.
line.choice-a-0.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-a-0.text: The guns will be in penny packets. When one is lost, nobody will admit the line required it to stand alone.
line.choice-a-1.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-a-1.text: The broad line buys delay in small amounts. Issue withdrawal times by sector. I want no new Leonidas deciding that his village is history's chosen pass.
line.choice-b-0.speaker: Major Edward Hale
line.choice-b-0.text: The outer villages will think we abandoned them before the battle.
line.choice-b-1.speaker: Petros Manesis
line.choice-b-1.text: Send runners before the Germans cut the telephones. Three hinges get the guns; the outer posts get trucks and an order they can actually obey.
